workflow.title: Shipping FAQ replies, urgent alerts and daily ticket digest
workflow.goal: For open tickets whose subject or body mentions 'shipping', send the shipping FAQ answer to the customer. Send urgent open tickets to mike@fitzone.com. Send all other open tickets to mike@fitzone.com in one daily digest.

assumptions: Only tickets with status 'open' are handled.
'Mentions shipping' means the word appears in the subject or body, ignoring case.
The digest lists every open non-urgent ticket, including shipping tickets that were auto-answered, so Mike sees the full set.
Each run sends one urgent email listing urgent tickets (or stating none) and one digest email.
risks: Customers receive an automatic reply from the outbox for every shipping ticket, so a false keyword match sends an unneeded reply.
An open shipping ticket is answered again on every run until its status changes to closed, so repeated runs send repeated replies to the same customer.
Mike receives an email on every run, including runs with no urgent or open tickets.
If the audit fails after sends, some emails may already have been delivered and cannot be recalled.
successCriteria: Every open shipping ticket has one FAQ reply sent to its customer address.
The number of FAQ replies sent equals the number of open shipping tickets.
Urgent open tickets are listed in one email to mike@fitzone.com.
All other open tickets are listed in one digest email to mike@fitzone.com.
The outbox audit confirms the recipients and message hashes match this run.
